{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "AVD-AZU-0023",
      "title": "Security alerts are not sent to account administrators",
      "resource": "azurerm_mssql_server_security_alert_policy.alertpolicy6",
      "severity": "LOW",
      "explanation": "The alert policy specifies a security engineer email address but does not enable notifications to subscription owners and administrators, which may delay their response to detected threats."
    }
  ],
  "patched_code": "resource "azurerm_mssql_server_security_alert_policy" "alertpolicy6" {
  resource_group_name        = azurerm_resource_group.example.name
  server_name                = azurerm_mssql_server.mssql6.name
  state                      = "Enabled"
  storage_endpoint           = azurerm_storage_account.security_storage_account.primary_blob_endpoint
  storage_account_access_key = azurerm_storage_account.security_storage_account.primary_access_key
  disabled_alerts = [
    "Sql_Injection",
    "Data_Exfiltration"
  ]
  retention_days       = 20
  email_account_admins = true
  email_addresses      = ["securityengineer@bridgecrew.io"]
}
",
  "fix_summary": "Enabled security alert notifications for account administrators and subscription owners by setting email_account_admins to true."
}
